This backend's package doc explicitly says it is "faithful to the contract's per-session metadata" and serves as "a worked example for new backends," so the omission breaks that invariant and would propagate to any new backend copied from it. Impact is currently limited because this store is test-only and never registered in production (per its own doc comment). Confidence: 0.9.
